Sometimes you want to shut off part of your network with a lever. Toggle Buses make that happen.

Place a §6ME Toggle Bus §fon a cable, attach a redstone source, and it connects or disconnects the network branch on the other side. Redstone on means connected. Redstone off means disconnected. Simple.

The §6ME Inverted Toggle Bus §fflips the logic: connected when there is no redstone, disconnected when there is. Useful for emergency shutoffs.

Toggle Buses use zero power at idle and cost 1 channel from the host cable. They do not isolate power draw, so a disconnected sub-network still tries to draw power from your energy cells.

§ePS:§f Chain a Redstone Repeater into multiple Toggle Buses to sequence parts of your network turning on in stages.
